output.reason: The added served version v1 [ev-acf4ed4bcd3b, ev-4bda269d1e81, ev-bde2792c197a] imposes nothing on its own, so kind none is supported, as the canonical check also finds. correction.statement: ClusterSecretStore now serves the new API version external-secrets.io/v1. Adding this version has no operational consequence on its own. The removal of v1alpha1, the removal of the conversion webhook and the storage-version change are separate changes.

consequence.statement: The new served version external-secrets.io/v1 of ClusterSecretStore can be used. Adding it does not reject, ignore or break anything. This statement makes no claim about earlier versions: v1alpha1 removal and the v1beta1 storage change are tracked as separate changes.
